summary.text: One of the fifty daughters of Danaus — by lot the bride of Aegius son of Egyptus when the sons of Aegyptus married the Danaids at Argos.

story.text: Apollodorus allots Mnestra to Aegius among the sons of Egyptus who drew lots for Danaus' daughters borne on a Phoenician woman — one of the seven pairings named before the mass slaughter of the wedding night. Hyginus lists her among the brides who killed their husbands.
